releaseNotes: v1.0.0-rc60: Fixed BDR & GPX trail starting so routes start from your actual GPS location or any typed street address (e.g. 4130 Sugarloaf Rd, Hendersonville, NC) with turn-by-turn road directions to the nearest trail entry instead of starting in another state, added Northbound/Southbound direction choice & full closed-loop wrap, fixed street-level zoom on START, and cleaned up active navigation banners.
